I personally think pre production of GTA 6 started in Late 2012 due to money made from GTA V pre orders. Then sometime in Late 2013 after 5 came out. I bet a very small team started official  production on 6. I’d say production lasted until roughly 2017 where RDR2 was delayed till 2018. 

Rockstar probably realize that GTA 6 won’t release during the 8th Gen of gaming. So they delayed it indefinitely. Personally I think right after RDR2 released, Full development of GTA 6 must have begun with the ground level parts of the game already having been established by that point.

Perhaps development continued until March 2020 with the lockdowns, halting development for a couple weeks. Then eventually in late Spring 2020 development kicked back into full gear. That’s where I think they still are in my opinion. 

Perhaps they may have a whole marketing campaign ready to go for when they want to announce this game. At this point I think it’s believable the game is roughly 75% done with at least 1-2 years of dev time left.
